about_the_game:
Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel-style survival defense game where you must hold your ground against endless waves of incoming monsters. Choose your hero, collect skills, upgrade your power, and fight to survive in fast-paced, action-packed battles.

With simple controls and auto-attacking gameplay, the focus is on strategy, positioning, and building your perfect skill combo. Each run offers a fresh experience thanks to random skill choices, item drops, and enemy patterns.

Key Features:

  • ⚔️ Endless wave-based defense: Survive against increasingly challenging hordes of enemies.

  • 🔄 Roguelike elements: No two runs are the same — adapt and experiment every time.

  • 🧙‍♂️ Multiple heroes and skills: Each hero comes with unique abilities and playstyles.

  • 💥 Upgrade and combine: Collect both active and passive skills to create powerful synergies.

  • 🧟‍♀️ Diverse enemies and epic bosses: Battle a wide variety of monsters with unique behaviors.

  • 🌍 Variety of maps: Different environments and layouts with unique challenges.
